placements.reason: Each selection is a new record identified by store position; rollback is another record (A01 rule 3). Identity entity (State 1, pre-contract data closure 2026-10-03): its id is not its content, so it cannot be a value (SPEC_STANDARD 15.1.1); entity + issued.

Computed once by the kernel for one implementation and corpus digest; no actor edits it (A04 rule 8). Identity value: it is keyed by its own facts, with no identifier of its own (SPEC_STANDARD 15.1.1); an equal record is the same record.

Immutable after issue; identity computed from content (A01 rule 1); never edited or deleted (A01 rule 6). Identity value: its id is computed from its own facts (A01 rule 1), so it is not an identifier of its own in the sense of SPEC_STANDARD 15.1.1 — an equal value is the same record, stored once.
Entity: requested -> approved | refused; approved -> used at most once (A10 rule 3, A11 rule 1).
Entity written in_flight before the send and concluded after it; unknown resolved by the owner (A11 rules 1, 3, 4).
Entity whose facts are fixed at creation (purpose, A01 rule 5) and never change; no retirement (M12). Its active version is derived from FlowActivation records.

Each selection is a new record identified by store position; switching back is another record (A01 rule 3, A06 rule 4). Identity entity (State 1, pre-contract data closure 2026-10-03): its id is not its content, so it cannot be a value (SPEC_STANDARD 15.1.1); entity + issued.

Immutable acyclic graph with nodes, edges and constants embedded; identity computed from content (A01 rule 1). Identity value: its id is computed from its own facts (A01 rule 1), so it is not an identifier of its own in the sense of SPEC_STANDARD 15.1.1 — an equal value is the same record, stored once.

Immutable code for one contract version; never deleted so rollback can select it (M05, A01 rule 6). Identity value: its id is computed from its own facts (A01 rule 1), so it is not an identifier of its own in the sense of SPEC_STANDARD 15.1.1 — an equal value is the same record, stored once.

Trace record written once per concluded attempt, skip or upstream failure; no operation edits or deletes one (A15 rule 1). Identity value: it is keyed by its own facts, with no identifier of its own (SPEC_STANDARD 15.1.1); an equal record is the same record.
Entity with a lifecycle: proposed -> accepted by the owner (A08 rule 7); ports and pin never change.
Entity that advances, waits and ends; status, outputs, waiting points (M20, embedded), resumptions and release change (A13, A14).

Entity whose facts are fixed at creation (purpose, A01 rule 5) and never change; no retirement (M02). Its current contract version and implementation are derived from later records, so the slot record itself is append-only.

Immutable record written with the attempt that produced it and kept with the trace; only its bytes are temporary (M22, A15 rule 3, State 5 read_spooled_file). Identity value: it is keyed by its own facts, with no identifier of its own (SPEC_STANDARD 15.1.1); an equal record is the same record.
Entity: active -> revoked by the owner (A10 rule 5).

Content-identified value record; bytes stored once per digest and never overwritten (A18 rule 4); kept as long as traces (K-10). Identity value: its id is computed from its own facts (A01 rule 1), so it is not an identifier of its own in the sense of SPEC_STANDARD 15.1.1 — an equal value is the same record, stored once.

Content-identified case; the corpus only grows and a case is never withdrawn (M06, A04 rule 1, A01 rule 6). Identity value: its id is computed from its own facts (A01 rule 1), so it is not an identifier of its own in the sense of SPEC_STANDARD 15.1.1 — an equal value is the same record, stored once.

One observation, issued once and never changed; written one per case (State 5 closed question 1). Identity entity (State 1, pre-contract data closure 2026-10-03): its id is not its content, so it cannot be a value (SPEC_STANDARD 15.1.1); entity + issued.
